en.headline: Government opens 179 graduate-grade civil service posts on Saturday
en.dek: Applications for Administrative Officer, Executive Officer II and four other degree grades run online until 11.59pm on 2 October, with a joint exam on 5 December.
body: The government will open the 2026-27 joint recruitment exercise for six civil service graduate grades on Saturday, 12 September, seeking 179 officers in all, the Civil Service Bureau said.

The targets are 40 Administrative Officers, 100 Executive Officers II, 10 Assistant Information Officers (General), four Assistant Trade Officers II, 14 Management Services Officers II and 11 Transport Officers II. The exercise is open to permanent residents of Hong Kong who meet the entry requirements, and to students taking a bachelor’s degree or equivalent who are due to graduate in the 2026-27 or 2027-28 academic years.

Applications must be submitted through the online system on the bureau’s website. The closing time is 11.59pm on 2 October, Hong Kong time. Eligible candidates will sit the Joint Recruitment Examination on 5 December in Hong Kong or in Beijing, Shanghai, London, New York, Toronto, Vancouver or Sydney.

Candidates need Level 2 in the Use of Chinese and Use of English papers of the Common Recruitment Examination, or an accepted equivalent, a pass in the CRE Aptitude Test, and a pass in the Basic Law and National Security Law Test at degree or professional grade. Those without the language or aptitude results may sit a designated CRE on the same December date; those yet to pass the law test must obtain a pass before 5 December, the bureau said.

zh.headline: 六個學位職系周六起聯招 合共179個空缺
zh.dek: 政務主任、二級行政主任等職位周六起接受網上申請，截止10月2日晚上11時59分，聯合招聘考試定於12月5日舉行。
body: 政府將於周六（9月12日）展開2026至27年度六個公務員學位職系聯合招聘，合共開設179個職位，公務員事務局公布。
招聘目標為政務主任40人、二級行政主任100人、助理新聞主任（一般工作）10人、二級助理貿易主任4人、二級管理參議主任14人，以及二級運輸主任11人。所有符合入職條件的香港永久性居民，以及正修讀學士學位或等同學歷、將於2026至27或2027至28學年畢業的學生均可申請。
申請人須經公務員事務局網站的網上系統遞交申請，截止時間為10月2日晚上11時59分（香港時間）。合資格申請人將於12月5日應考聯合招聘考試，地點包括香港，以及北京、上海、倫敦、紐約、多倫多、溫哥華及悅尼。
申請人須取得綜合招聘考試中、英文運用試卷二級成績或獲承認的等同成績、能力傾向測驗及格，以及學位或專業程度職系《基本法及香港國安法》測試及格。尚未取得語文或能力傾向成績者，可於12月5日應考指定綜合招聘考試；尚未通過國安法測試者須在該日前取得及格成績。
